result: 9 passed. net_paid_cents equals zero on both closing paths and every authorization row reads VOIDED once its void is confirmed. F9 blocks LS-10 while a capture is pending, then refunds it. F24 keeps the lot FAILING across repeated passes when a refund cannot complete and raises one structured ERROR alert. An AUTHORIZING seat blocks LS-10 because no void row proves it, and a lot with an authorize still in flight is not failed at all: BO-03's re-check only lets that retry run while the lot is still CHECKOUT_OPEN, so failing over first would strand the seat with no contracted exit (Q-2026-11-01-18). A FAILING lot expires the OFFERED, ORDER_CREATED and APPROVED offers whose deadline passed (BO-15 to BO-17). Every pass that could not balance the lot scheduled the next one itself, escalating from 10 s to 300 s after six passes, and a second refund of one capture takes the next sequence so its idempotency key is never reused.
note: F9 and F24 are written in the fault files, which carry both the integration and faults markers, so the gate's '-m faults' run collects each of them once. The pre-existing fault files carry only the integration marker and are not selected by that command.
